ShortDescription.Value: Group buildings into collections and fill a whole city block with them in one click.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Why this mod exists** This started as a personal project. I watched YouTubers such as JustJoeG build whole streets out of hand-picked buildings, and nothing I found on Paradox Mods did quite what I needed, so I made my own. It has been working well for me, so I decided to share it in case someone else is in the same situation.
Collections Builder does two things: it lets you keep your own **collections** of buildings, and it uses them to **build whole city blocks** in one go.
**Collections** - A collection is a named list of buildings you pick yourself: a style, a theme, a street mood, anything. - With the panel open and a collection selected, Shift+click a building in Find It or in the game's asset menu to add it, or add everything Find It is currently showing with one button. - With the "Tag collections in Find It" option on, every collection is also a **Find It tag**, so you can browse it straight from Find It. - Browse a collection as cards (thumbnail, name, lot size, level), search it, filter it, and remove buildings you no longer want.
**Block builder** - Click a block surrounded by roads, or draw a polygon, and pick a collection. - The mod lays buildings from that collection along every sidewalk, facing the street, with corner buildings on the corners when the collection has them. It also handles curved streets. - Filter by lot width, depth and level, and set the density (how much of the street front gets built). - Preview the result as a transparent plan, press Reshuffle for another random layout with the same rules, and press Build when you like it. No zoning needed: **Plop the Growables** keeps the placed buildings from being condemned. - Optional trees in the leftover space inside the block.
**Required mods** - **Plop the Growables**: buildings placed without zoning would otherwise be condemned by the game. - **Anarchy**: needed for the overlap between buildings. The builder tab shows a warning if either is missing.
**Your saves** - The builder only places regular buildings from your own collections (and, if you turn them on, ordinary trees), the same objects you could place by hand. It adds no new assets and does not change any game rules. - Your collections and settings live in the mod's own settings folder, not in the save. - This mod writes nothing to the save. Saves from 0.3.3 or earlier carried a small marker on the buildings it placed; it is removed when you load them with this version, and gone from the file once you save again. - Keeping the placed buildings from being condemned is done by Plop the Growables, which is why it is a required mod.
**Mixing two collections** - Fill a block from two collections at once and choose the proportion with a slider, for example 70 % of one style and 30 % of another.
**Overlap** - Street lengths are rarely a multiple of the 8 m lot grid, so a strict layout leaves gaps at street ends and along curves. - With "Overlap per joint" (0.5 to 2 m), neighbouring buildings may overlap each other by up to that much, so they always touch and the leftover goes to the corner instead of showing as gaps between buildings. Existing buildings are never removed or overlapped. - Overlap uses the **Anarchy** mod: the builder turns Anarchy on while its tab is open and turns it back off when you leave (only if it was the one that turned it on). Set it to Off to build without overlap.
Find It is optional (it is only used for adding buildings and for tags). Early version: feedback and bug reports are welcome on GitHub.
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.3.4 - Plop the Growables and Anarchy are now required mods. Protection from being condemned is left to Plop the Growables, so this mod no longer writes anything to the save; the old marker is removed from existing saves on load. - The builder tab warns when a required mod is missing.
0.3.3 - Faster reshuffles: filling the last uncovered street cells no longer stalls for seconds on polygon selections and large collections.
0.3.2 - Blocks with a short side between two corners: the corner next to the short side no longer stays empty when the short side cannot hold its own corner building.
0.3.1 - Faster preview for large selections (several blocks or a big polygon): about three times quicker, same result.
0.3.0 - Click a building in a collection to place it directly with the game's placement tool, no Find It needed. - While placing a building from the selected collection, the Reshuffle key (T by default) switches to another random building from the ones shown in the Collections tab.
0.2.0 - Editable polygon, like the game's areas: drag a corner to move it (it still snaps to the sidewalk), drag the dot in the middle of a side to add a corner, right-click a corner to remove it. The selection and preview update when you release.
0.1.40 - first test release (private). - With overlap enabled, neighbouring buildings along a sidewalk touch each other (overlapping at most the configured value) instead of leaving gaps between them; any leftover stays at the corner. - Curved streets: the short segments of a curve are filled, with the overlap measured at the facade, so buildings follow the curve with far fewer empty spots (some very tight curves still leave gaps). - Narrow blocks: facing streets are both built, with backs allowed to overlap. - Empty facade cells between buildings are filled as a last resort with a one-cell-wide building.
